citation.ref: Epoch AI, Data on AI Models

provenance: Training time (hours) field of Epoch AI's all_ai_models.csv, downloaded 2026-09-25 (sha256 in PROVENANCE.md), divided by 24 and rounded half up to 0.1 day; the same values as the author's training_length.csv export. One point per model: x is the release date as a fractional year (Epoch's Publication date), y is days. The 26 language models, 2019 to 2025, were chosen by the author for recognizability. epochParams is Epoch's Parameters field; sizeDisclosed is false where the developer never published a size (GPT-4 and Grok 3, whose Epoch sizes are rumors; Gemini 1.0 Ultra and Mistral Large, which Epoch leaves blank). basis: 'reported' = the developer states the duration; 'derived' = worked out from the developer's own figures; 'estimate' = Epoch's own estimate or a third-party figure Epoch records. Each model's 'how' line summarizes Epoch's note, and 'source' links where the developer stated the figure (reported or derived rows) or Epoch's database (estimates). No value comes from outside Epoch's database.

models.name: RoBERTa
models.how: Worked out from Facebook's reported steps and GPUs.
models.epochNote: First the model is pretrained for 100k steps on 1024 GPUs for 1 day, then pretraining is increased to 500k steps, so assuming they used the same number of GPUs, this would have taken 5 days.

models.name: Megatron-LM
models.how: Epoch's estimate, from NVIDIA's reported throughput.
models.epochNote: Reported throughput is 15.1 teraFLOPS per GPU on 512 GPUs Assume total compute is 9.1e21 FLOP. Then training time is 327 hours. https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=9.1*10%5E21+FLOP+%2F+%28512*15.1+teraFLOPS%29

models.name: Gopher
models.how: Reported by DeepMind.
models.epochNote: "We trained Gopher for 920 hours in November and December 2020 in Google’s Georgia datacentre. The PUE of the datacenter at this time was 1.08; the net tCO2e per MWh in October 2020 was 0.33. Using an estimate of 283W drawn per chip, this leads to a total of 380 net tCO2e"

models.name: GLaM
models.how: Worked out from Google's reported energy figures.
models.epochNote: Note that they give several energy estimates. Use the complete training figures for 600B tokens, not the GPT-3 comparison values with 280B tokens. "326W measured system power per TPU-v4 chip" "The complete GLaM training using 600B tokens consumes only 456 MWh" 1024 TPU v4 chips (456 MWh) / (326W/chip * 1024 chips) = 1366 hours

models.name: AlphaCode
models.how: Worked out from DeepMind's reported TPU-days and TPU count.
models.epochNote: Figure 7 (a) shows that the models were trained for around 23000 TPU-days. We know they trained on TPUv4s, and in appendix D.1 they say they have 3750 TPUv4 and TPUv4i. Assuming they trained only on the 3750 TPUv4s, that suggests 23000 / 3750 = 6.13 days, or 147.2 hours.
